Subject: Significant service degradation — high 5xx rate and throughput drop

Karthik,

We're seeing a sustained degradation across our Redwood-backed inference endpoints since ~07:50 PDT. Symptoms:
- Throughput down ~60% versus baseline (p95 request rate)
- 5xx spike to 7% (was <0.1% prior to 07:45)
- Tail latency for user-facing queries > 6s (p99)

This is impacting our production flows and payments processing. I've attached a short sample of error logs and our API metrics exports. Can you confirm whether you see any regional capacity events or model fallback activity on your side? We need an urgent mitigation path and an ETA for recovery.

Attachments: stratus_error_sample.log (log excerpt), api_metrics_20270422.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Significant service degradation — high 5xx rate and throughput drop — triage notes and immediate actions

Folks — quick triage notes from the initial look (pre-bridge):

Observations (08:30 PDT snapshot):
- Elevated 5xxs originate primarily from the route /v1/generate (70% of errors).
- Model-variant fallback triggered from rtx-large -> rtx-small for ~18% of requests during spike window. Fallback appears to be correlated with cold KV cache misses for long-prefix requests.
- Autoscaler shows queued warm-up instances that did not transition to serving within the expected 90s window (suspect provisioning bottleneck in the pool).
- No infra-wide cloud provider outage in the region; capacity appears available but warm-up latency is high.

Immediate actions (doing now):
1) Enable temporary routing policy to route read-heavy non-critical endpoints to the dedicated fallback pool (Vivek).
2) Bump autoscale parallelism + shorten warm-up timeout to allow faster instance readiness (Marissa).
3) Apply aggressive KV cache priming for observed long-prefix tokens and enable prefix caching override for Stratus tenant (Laura).
4) If throughput doesn't recover in 15–20 minutes, deploy model-variant quota limits to throttle background/async jobs and free synchronous capacity (Karthik).

Requested from Stratus: session-level request IDs for sample window and any recent deployment or traffic shift that could explain longer token sequences (Amira).

Attaching a short triage snapshot: triage_snapshot.txt (contains traces and relevant metric links).

--
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Incident Response — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0140
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@stratus.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, support@stratus.io
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Update: mitigation in progress and next steps (STR-2467)

Amira — quick status update following the 08:40 bridge and the actions Laura's team executed: 

What we changed (completed by 09:55 PDT):
- Temporarily routed non-critical read endpoints to a warmed dedicated pool — immediate effect: throughput recovered ~40% in the first 10 minutes.
- Autoscale warm-up parallelism increased; provisioning latency reduced by ~60% (measured).
- Prefix KV cache priming applied for the top 15 long-prefix tokens observed in your traffic; this reduced cache miss rate for those patterns.
- We have not yet implemented model-variant quota throttles; we will only do this if throughput doesn't stabilize in the next 20 minutes.

Current status: error rate down from 7% to ~0.8% (averaged last 10m). Tail latency (p99) improved to ~2.1s but still above target. We're monitoring closely.

Next steps & ETA:
- Continued monitoring for the next 60 minutes; full recovery (below 0.2% 5xx and p99 < 1s) expected if trend continues — target 11:10 PDT.
- If we see a reversion, we will execute the model-variant quota plan and coordinate an additional capacity burst.
- Post-incident: we'll provide a one-page RCA with timeline, root causes, and recommended adjustments to your routing/async config (deliverable by EOD tomorrow).

Links: incident timeline and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_incident_artifacts
PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incident/STR-2467/20270422

Please reply if you'd like us to keep the cadence at 15-min updates or switch to slack/higher-frequency channel.

Thanks — we're treating this as high priority.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0123
